note: PhotoCraft (MIT OR Apache-2.0; ArtCraft's name and logo are its authors'): an image editor in Rust. Its web build (apps/photocraft-web, wasm) is the photo window's editor, and its headless command line (apps/photocraft-cli) is what the agent's photo_* tools run. Both are built from this commit by scripts/build-photo.mjs, with photo/overlay laid over the web app, into dist/photo/. Bump the sha to take a newer one.
